messages:
Nora Patel: Quick kickoff for VelaHealth onboarding - aim: pilot within 30 days, surface any immediate renewal risks. Who takes what? :wave:
Ben Torres: I'll take integration touchpoints and API keys flow. Plan to run a dry-run of requests by day 5.
Elena Martinez: I'll own enablement and playbook. Propose two 45-min sessions: integration + ops, and prompt tuning + evals. Target wk1 and wk2.
Samir Rao: Data & compliance here. Need sample payloads and retention requirements. Also request copy of their DPA and SOC2 attestation.
Nora Patel: I already asked for SOC2 and DPA in the intro email. Will follow up if no reply by EOD.
Ben Torres: For the pilot infra, suggestion: start with small Dedicated pool, batch size 4, prefix cache on. That should give consistent latency while we validate.
Elena Martinez: Enablement checklist v0:
- Day 0: Stakeholder intros + roles
- Day 2: API integration walk-through
- Day 6: Prompt engineering fundamentals + sample prompts
- Day 12: Failover & monitoring runbook
- Day 30: Pilot review + renewal discussion
I'll post the slide deck after the first session.
Samir Rao: Risk flags: renewal-risk: low-medium (pilot budget unclear), exec sponsor: none yet. Data-risk: potential PHI fields in payloads - will need redaction plan.
Nora Patel: Action items summary:
- Nora: secure exec intro + chase SOC2/DPA (today)
- Ben: dry-run API by day 5 + post request sample to the thread
- Elena: finalize enablement sessions + prompt eval set (wk1)
- Samir: draft redaction/retention options + KMS notes (48h)
OnboardBot: Calendar invite created: "VelaHealth Onboarding - Kickoff" on 2025-10-06 10:00 PDT.
Ben Torres: I'll create a ticket in the tracker with config recommendations and link sample responses.
Elena Martinez: We'll also run a 10-case prompt regression before/after configs. Posting the template in the doc repo.
Nora Patel: Thanks all. If the customer pushes back on timeline, we'll escalate to CSM manager. Please post blockers here. :thumbsup:
